status: preliminary content observations; not efficacy evaluation

grounding_review.explanation: 文章中に文法と慣用句の誤用が見られる。例えば、"In the other hand" は "On the other hand" の誤用であり、"he fail the first time" は "he failed the first time" の誤用である。これらの誤用は全体的な意味の理解を妨げないが、文法的な正確さには影響を与える。

observations.finding: The grounding explanation mentions In the other hand found in the full target, but this phrase is outside the selected evidence spans. The same claim also contains a tense example actually in the selected spans. Existence of support somewhere in full text does not validate every selected citation or every combined subclaim.
observations.next_prompt_change: Require separate support decision for each atomic proposition and each selected evidence span; additions of evidence IDs must be explicit and checked separately.

observations.finding: Pilot patterns include broad structures/grammar descriptions. Two distinct target IDs establish a count condition, not the semantic specificity or validity of a shared pattern.
Some generated high-score explanations are Chinese despite Japanese instructions. These high-score candidates failed Overall reconstruction and were not used as adopted evidence.
All pilot reviewed claims were labeled supported by the same local model. This is a provisional model judgment, not independently measured support accuracy.
